//: THE VERIFIED TIER of the Mochiii MCP marketplace. Each entry here was chosen by a person: an official
server from the vendor itself, published in the official MCP Registry under the vendor's own verified
namespace (registryName), or -- where the registry does not list it -- one of the MCP project's own
reference servers (manual). Everything else in the catalog is community tier: imported, not reviewed.
Fields here OVERRIDE what the registry says. `env` replaces the registry's variables where it hands a
credential over as a value typed into the command line (GitHub, Terraform) or does not declare the one
the server needs (Perplexity): Mochiii passes variables by NAME only. Versions come from the registry at
each `npm run mcp:sync`, so every bump of a verified server is a line in that commit's diff.
Left out on purpose: servers whose job Mochiii's own confined tools already do (filesystem, git, fetch)
-- an unconfined copy of a confined tool is all risk and no gain -- and official servers that turn on
write access by default (PagerDuty pins --enable-write-tools) or cannot be pinned (SonarQube's image
has no tag). Those still appear in the community tier with exactly what they run.

servers.name: Context7
servers.description: Up-to-date, version-specific documentation and code examples for libraries, pulled into the model's context on request.

servers.name: Playwright
servers.description: Drive a real browser with Playwright: navigate, click, fill forms and read pages through the accessibility tree.

servers.name: Chrome DevTools
servers.description: Inspect and debug a live Chrome: network requests, console, performance traces and DOM, from the Chrome DevTools team.

servers.name: GitHub
servers.description: GitHub's official server: repositories, issues, pull requests, code search and Actions, through your own token.

env.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: A GitHub personal access token. Scope it to what you want Mochiii to reach.

servers.name: Brave Search
servers.description: Web, news, image and local search through the Brave Search API.

servers.name: Tavily
servers.description: Web search, extraction and crawling built for AI agents, through the Tavily API.

servers.name: Firecrawl
servers.description: Scrape, crawl and search the web into clean markdown, through the Firecrawl API.

servers.name: Perplexity
servers.description: Real-time web search, reasoning and research through Perplexity's API.

servers.name: Sentry
servers.description: Sentry issues, errors, traces and releases, for debugging with the stack trace in front of the model.

servers.name: Grafana
servers.description: Search dashboards, query data sources and read alerts and incidents in your Grafana instance.

env.name: GRAFANA_URL
env.description: The URL of your Grafana instance.

servers.name: Supabase
servers.description: Manage Supabase projects: tables, SQL, migrations, edge functions and logs.

servers.name: MongoDB
servers.description: Query and manage a MongoDB database: collections, documents, indexes and aggregations.

env.name: MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING
env.description: The connection string of the database to work with.

servers.name: Redis
servers.description: Read, write and search data in Redis in natural language, from Redis's official server.

servers.name: Kubernetes
servers.description: Work with Kubernetes and OpenShift clusters through your kubeconfig: pods, deployments, logs and resources.

env.name: KUBECONFIG
env.description: The kubeconfig to use, if not ~/.kube/config.

servers.name: Terraform
servers.description: Terraform Registry providers, modules and policies, and HCP Terraform workspaces. Runs Terraform operations only if you enable them yourself.

env.name: TFE_TOKEN
env.description: An HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise token, for workspace tools. Registry lookups work without it.

env.name: TFE_ADDRESS
env.description: Your Terraform Enterprise URL, if you do not use HCP Terraform.

servers.name: Azure
servers.description: Azure services from one server: storage, databases, monitoring, resource groups and more, as your signed-in Azure identity.

servers.name: Snyk
servers.description: Find and fix vulnerabilities in code, dependencies, containers and infrastructure-as-code with the Snyk CLI.

env.name: SNYK_TOKEN
env.description: A Snyk API token. Without it, run `snyk auth` once.

servers.name: Browserbase
servers.description: Browser automation in Browserbase's cloud browsers, driven by Stagehand.

env.name: MEMORY_FILE_PATH
env.description: Where to keep the knowledge graph. Set it, or the graph may not outlive a package cache clean.

servers.name: Memory
servers.description: A persistent knowledge graph the model can write to and recall from across conversations. An MCP reference server.

servers.name: Sequential Thinking
servers.description: A structured tool for step-by-step problem solving that can revise and branch its own reasoning. An MCP reference server.

servers.name: Time
servers.description: The current time in any timezone, and conversions between timezones. An MCP reference server.
